newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey-American Water buys water system.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey-American Water buys water system.

text.p: New Jersey-American Water Co, the state's largest water utility, said it had completed its acquisition of the Howell Township (Monmouth County) Municipal Water System for $35.1 million, in what it described as the largest private acquisition of a municipal water system in U.S. history.

The company is a subsidiary of American Water Works Company Inc, the country's largest investor-owned water utility, providing service to more than seven million people in 800 communities of 21 states.
